titulo: Two columns for every real decision
caption:
Two columns for every real decision

My friend runs a two-column list for every real decision. Then the tally says what the gut already knew.

Writing it out takes two minutes, and the tally is hard to argue with.

For whoever writes the yes and no columns before deciding.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a sheet of paper on the right with two columns, YES and NO. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes in the middle says just go with your gut. A ink-black block figure with white eyes at the left answers paper first, and tally marks appear: three under YES and one under NO. The blue one's eyes go wide and says fine, it's a yes. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me making two columns.
